Memory fix: local models now free your RAM and VRAM by themselves.

- **Automatic unload.** Ollama unloads a model one minute after the last readscout call (it was 30 minutes in 0.1.0,
  so a 26B model could keep about 14 GB of RAM busy long after the agent was done). Calls made close together still
  reuse the loaded model.
- **Unload when the session ends.** When Claude Code or Codex closes, the readscout server unloads the models it used
  right away. Nothing for the agent to remember or to check.
- **`readscout stop`** frees the memory immediately if you want it now.
- **Clearer skill:** agents must never start, pull or switch models or inference servers themselves; the three tools
  are the only way in.
- **Windows:** when readscout has to start Ollama, Ollama now outlives the agent session instead of being killed with it.

Update: run the installer again, or `uv tool install --force https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.1/readscout-0.1.1-py3-none-any.whl`.
Plugin users: `/plugin marketplace update readscout`, then restart Claude Code.
